blaster.name: Blaster
blaster.description: Ranged damage specialist with high offensive power but low defenses

inherent.name: Defiance
inherent.description: Attacking grants stacking damage bonus. First two Primary and first Secondary power usable while mezzed.

controller.name: Controller
controller.description: Mezzes enemies and buffs/debuffs with strong team support

inherent.name: Containment
inherent.description: Double damage vs Held, Immobilized, Slept, or Disoriented targets. Applied after enhancements.

defender.name: Defender
defender.description: Support specialist with powerful buffs, debuffs, and healing

inherent.name: Vigilance
inherent.description: Solo/small teams: +6-30% damage (scales with level). Endurance discount when teammates are injured. 3+ teammates = no damage bonus.

scrapper.name: Scrapper
scrapper.description: Melee damage dealer with good survivability through defense/resistance

inherent.name: Critical Hit
inherent.description: 5% crit chance vs minions (double damage), 10% vs lieutenants/bosses. Average +5-10% damage bonus.

tanker.name: Tanker
tanker.description: Extremely tough with highest HP and strong defensive powers

inherent.name: Gauntlet
inherent.description: PunchVoke: ST attacks taunt target + 4 nearby, AoE taunts all. +50% AoE radius/range, +50% cone arc. PBAoE hits bonus targets at 33% damage.

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.description: Rebirth exclusive: Assault primary with armor/utility Composition secondary. Defeat-driven Resolve grants stacking absorb + status protection to nearby allies.

inherent.name: Resolve
inherent.description: When an enemy is defeated, nearby Guardians and allies gain a stack of Resolve for 15s: +5% Absorb plus protection from Disorient, Hold, Sleep, Immobilize, Fear, and Confuse. Stacks up to 3 outside PvP. In PvP, defeating a player grants 20% Absorb (no stacking).

brute.name: Brute
brute.description: High damage melee fighter that builds fury through combat

inherent.name: Fury
inherent.description: Build fury (0-100) by attacking and being attacked. Each fury point grants +2% damage, up to +200% at max fury.

corruptor.name: Corruptor
corruptor.description: Ranged damage dealer with debuffs and support abilities

inherent.name: Scourge
inherent.description: Chance for double damage when enemies are below 50% HP. 2.5% per 1% below 50%, guaranteed at 10% HP. ~30% avg damage bonus.

dominator.name: Dominator
dominator.description: Control specialist with strong offensive capabilities

inherent.name: Domination
inherent.description: Build meter by attacking, activate at 90%+ for 2× mez magnitude, 1.5× mez duration, mez protection, and full endurance. Lasts 90s.

mastermind.name: Mastermind
mastermind.description: Pet commander with support abilities for minions

inherent.name: Supremacy
inherent.description: Henchmen within 60ft gain +25% Damage and +10% ToHit. Bodyguard Mode (Defensive/Follow) splits damage: 66% to you, 33% to pets.

stalker.name: Stalker
stalker.description: Stealthy assassin with critical strikes from hide

inherent.name: Assassination
inherent.description: From Hide: 100% critical (double damage). Outside: 10% base + 3% per teammate. Assassin's Focus grants up to +100% crit for Assassin's Strike.

peacebringer.name: Peacebringer
peacebringer.description: Kheldian shapeshifter with access to multiple forms. Can transform between human, nova (ranged), and dwarf (melee/tank) forms.

inherent.name: Cosmic Balance
inherent.description: Peacebringers bring balance to their team. Damage increases per nearby Tanker/Mastermind/Corruptor/Defender. Damage Resistance increases per nearby Scrapper/Brute/Stalker/Blaster. Control protection per nearby Controller/Dominator. Slow resistance per nearby Kheldian/Arachnos teammate.

warshade.name: Warshade
warshade.description: Kheldian shapeshifter that feeds on defeated enemies. Can summon pets from fallen foes and transform between forms.

inherent.name: Dark Sustenance
inherent.description: Warshades draw on the power of their teammates. Damage Resistance increases per nearby Tanker/Mastermind/Corruptor/Defender. Damage increases per nearby Scrapper/Stalker/Brute/Blaster. Control protection per nearby Controller/Dominator. Slow resistance per nearby Kheldian/Arachnos teammate.

arachnos-soldier.name: Arachnos Soldier
arachnos-soldier.description: Versatile soldier with branching power choices. Can specialize as a Crab Spider (pets/support) or Bane Spider (stealth/melee).

inherent.name: Conditioning
inherent.description: Increased maximum HP and inherent resistance to status effects.

arachnos-widow.name: Arachnos Widow
arachnos-widow.description: Versatile operative with branching power choices. Can specialize as a Fortunata (psychic powers) or Night Widow (melee assassin).

inherent.name: Conditioning
inherent.description: Increased maximum HP and inherent resistance to status effects.
